allow: Bash(./target/release/devsql --no-cache "CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE t USING fts5\(x\); INSERT INTO t VALUES \('hello world'\); SELECT * FROM t WHERE t MATCH 'hello'")
Bash(time devsql --rebuild-cache -f json "SELECT COUNT\(*\) FROM transcripts")
Bash(sqlite3 ~/.claude/.devsql-cache.db "SELECT name, SUM\(pgsize\) / 1024 / 1024 || ' MB' AS size FROM dbstat GROUP BY name ORDER BY SUM\(pgsize\) DESC LIMIT 20")

Bash(sqlite3 ~/.claude/.devsql-cache.db "SELECT COUNT\(*\) as rows, SUM\(LENGTH\(content\)\)/1024/1024 || ' MB' as content_bytes, MAX\(LENGTH\(content\)\)/1024 || ' KB' as max_row, AVG\(LENGTH\(content\)\) as avg FROM transcripts")
Bash(time devsql -f json "SELECT COUNT\(*\) FROM transcripts WHERE content LIKE '%papertrail%'")
Bash(time devsql -f json "SELECT COUNT\(*\) FROM transcripts WHERE rowid IN \(SELECT rowid FROM transcripts_fts WHERE transcripts_fts MATCH 'papertrail'\)")

Bash(time devsql -f json "SELECT project, session_id, type, role, substr\(content, 1, 80\) as snippet FROM transcripts WHERE rowid IN \(SELECT rowid FROM transcripts_fts WHERE transcripts_fts MATCH 'papertrail solarwinds'\) AND timestamp >= '2026-05-01' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 3")
